statements.statement: CPT 93229 mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered for the patient
The patient presented with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat (R00.2)
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The symptoms are concerning for potential arrhythmias
The monitoring was required to capture continuous rhythm data during daily activities
The monitoring was to correlate reported symptoms with any underlying cardiac conduction abnormalities
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
